answer: Seed trust in a few long-lived relic artifacts, work peers have relied on for epochs, and require every new claim to carry a quill signature from its author plus citations to what it builds on. Random walks start at the relics and voyage through the citation graph: honest work sits a few hops away, while a sybil farm and its dense self-citations form an island with almost no bridges to the mainland. Rank by walk-arrival probability, not headcount, so spawning a thousand islands buys no shore.
